regulatory.detail: No public FDA marketing application established in this collection. Trial registration/publication is not authorization.

labeling.detail: No commercial labeling assigned to this investigational entry; protocol/publication evidence is separate.

inventory.method: FDA original PMA page link inventory using public web retrieval; discovery may be cached. Direct FDA document downloads were blocked by the provider. No assertion of current revision or complete labeling review.

safety.detail: No reliable application-based recall join is available; no safety clearance is inferred.
limits: Recall API coverage begins in 2002; earlier recalls are not exhaustively covered. Malformed direct identifiers are excluded from accepted joins and shown separately for review.
Only root pma_numbers/k_numbers used for joins; recognized PMA supplements normalize to their parent application. Harmonized manufacturer identifiers and name similarity are excluded.
FDA notice index pages for 2023–2026 screened by explicit product/class terms; pre-2023 web archives and manufacturer notices not exhaustively reviewed.

Source-field audits and notice-scope decisions are distinct from clinical signoff or patient/unit matching. FDA recall status is as reported in the dated snapshot. MAUDE and enforcement reconciliation are outside this review.

labelReview.scope: BrainGate2 research system; trial/publication evidence rather than commercial labeling

findings.text: The registered feasibility study seeks preliminary safety information and proof of principle for an implanted neural interface.
Research participation, protocol eligibility and informed consent govern use; a registration is not successful-treatment evidence or marketing authorization.

sources.title: ClinicalTrials.gov BrainGate2 feasibility study
sources.method: Editorial inspection of publicly retrieved primary-source text/excerpts; indexed age can differ from access date. Full current IFU certification is separate.

limitations: No public commercial IFU, marketing application or reliable application-based recall join is established. Safety results from other BrainGate studies cannot automatically be assigned to this speech-cortex protocol.

researchEvidence.title: Feasibility of the BrainGate2 Neural Interface System in Persons With Tetraplegia

interventions.description: Placement of the BrainGate2 sensor(s) into the speech-related cortex
interventions.name: BrainGate Neural Interface System

researchEvidence.summary: The purpose of this study is to obtain preliminary device safety information and demonstrate proof of principle (feasibility) of the ability of people with tetraplegia to control a computer cursor and other assistive devices with their thoughts.

researchEvidence.title: Interim Safety Profile From the Feasibility Study of the BrainGate Neural Interface System.

review.method: Primary-source, model-scoped editorial review. Current public safety statements are distinguished from historical labels and full IFUs. No clinical certification or patient-specific applicability determination.
